svg.title: Pending scheduled run evidence
svg.desc: An explicit placeholder stating no genuine live scheduled run detail has been captured.
svg.text: EVIDENCE PENDING - NOT A SCHEDULED-RUN DETAIL
The local fixture run is manual and must never be substituted for `schedule` evidence.
Replace before submission with one real workflow detail page showing:
- event: `schedule`, mode: `live`, and actual started/finished timestamps;
- source-health, credit, and notification outcomes from the uploaded artifact;
- the same immutable run ID copied into the evidence pack.
No Sectors key or GitHub Actions schedule result is embedded in this image.
